title: Lowe’s associates surprise 100-year-old daily walker with birthday party
summary: Lowe’s associates surprise 100-year-old daily walker with birthday party
body_markdown:
##


When Gretchen Sollo is late for her morning walk, people at the Lowe’s store in Bradley, Illinois notice.


Over the years, Sollo’s steady steps through the aisles have become a daily ritual and an act of resilience after a stroke. What began as a practical way to stay active indoors soon became a cherished part of her day.


So did the people who


work


there.


Associates stop


to talk


as she passes. They ask how many laps she’s walking. Some challenge her to a race. And if she doesn’t arrive when expected, they wonder where she is.


As her 100th birthday approached, the Lowe’s team decided to surprise one of its most familiar visitors.


About 50 people gathered inside the store, including associates, friends and family. Some associates came in on their day off. A store aisle was decorated with a blue carpet and an arch of birthday balloons, with a cake and special Lowe’s vest waiting for Sollo.


“I still can’t get over it,” she said. “I look around and there’s somebody else I know. They’re all here.”


It was, she said, her first proper birthday party.
